name: Lugar v. Edmondson Oil Co.
summary: The Supreme Court held that a private party's misuse of state procedures can constitute state action when the conduct is fairly attributable to the state, satisfying the color of law requirement for Section 1983 claims.
significance: This case established a two-part test for determining whether a private party's conduct constitutes state action, which is directly relevant to evaluating Watanabe's liability under Section 1983.
